description: This PHP source file defines the class DestroyPurgeStrategy, which extends PurgeStrategy, and implements a method to purge entity records associated with an employee number within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class responsible for deleting (purging) entities related to a specific employee number within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes entity records identified by the employee number by retrieving them and removing each via the entity manager.
